Fixes bug Bc28808f9c3: tests/test_uc_surf_setup_ops_transcript.json records a failing transcript: every command exits 1 with 'ddflow: imported from the linked worktree <path>/UX-output-caps-low-followups ... the shared editable install was reset', a path of whichever worktree last re-recorded it. The test is red in every other linked worktree (path differs) and 'pins regenerate --only setup-ops-transcript' run from a linked worktree re-records the same error with its own path (183 changed lines, no real content), burning a single-use approval. Expected: the pin is recorded from the primary / with the path masked, and regenerate refuses or masks a linked-worktree import error. Found on B-dup-closure.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-Bc28808f9c3 --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed Bc28808f9c3 --regression-test <test>` first).

Fixes bug Bbaaaba1364: During gate run ci the suite's swarm pilot tests spawn ddflow init and the foreign-launch guard (surfaces/cli._guard_foreign_launch) sees the import from the /tmp/ddflow-ci.* scratch tree as another lane's linked worktree, resets the shared editable install and refuses (exit 1: 're-run the command'). The tests pass from the primary tree (61 passed) and fail inside ci, so ci reports them as new failures not failing on main and the item cannot get a clean ci outcome; observed on DX-update-universal in two runs.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-Bbaaaba1364 --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed Bbaaaba1364 --regression-test <test>` first).

Fixes bug Bdc7cd5b259: tests/test_update_edit_parity.py chdirs to tmp_path, so guard_foreign_launch sees a foreign worktree import and cli.main returns before reaching the api; the unit_tests gate then reports it as a new failure on every worktree lane touching its reach. Fixed in this lane by stubbing the guard in the test; other tests that chdir and call cli.main may share it.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-Bdc7cd5b259 --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed Bdc7cd5b259 --regression-test <test>` first).

Repro: uv run pytest tests/test_uc_mcp_handshake_vars.py -k template_engine. Found on B181.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B19157c3453 --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B19157c3453 --regression-test <test>` first).
